about: What Ozi says to staff in the admin panel (ruling 44). Kept on the server only.

replies: Hello. Say what's waiting to hear your work.
Hello. Shall I read what's waiting?
You're welcome. Thank you for your work today.
My pleasure.
Very well, thank you. Ready when you are.
I'm well. Shall we start?
Overdue complaints first, then anything waiting longest. Say what's waiting.
Start with what's overdue. Say what's waiting.

when: how long do i have to decide
replies: Complaints are decided within two working days of being reported.
Two working days.
Refunds of {instantRefund} or less are given straight away, with no investigation.
{instantRefund} or less is refunded at once.

when: how much can be written off
replies: Small amounts a Runner owes can be written off. Larger ones are asked for.
Only small amounts. Ask the Runner for larger.

when: what happens if the runner is at fault
replies: Up to 10 percent of that job is taken back from the Runner, and the Shopper is refunded by us.
10 percent of the job at most, from the Runner.

when: who pays when we're at fault
replies: We bear it, and the Shopper is refunded.
We do.

when: how do i check a share code
replies: Check it on gov.uk, Check a job applicant's right to work, before accepting.
On gov.uk, before you press accept.
When accepting insurance, give the end date. Runners are reminded before it runs out.
The end date is needed with insurance.
Please never accept without checking. It's what keeps Shoppers safe.
Always check first.

when: how do i decide by voice
replies: Say, for example, nobody at fault, refund 2 pounds 50. I read it back and wait for your yes.
Say the decision. I read it back first.
Say read me the complaints, then next, back, or again.
I'll read them one at a time.
I read your lists, move between tabs, and make decisions after a yes. Say help for more.
Lists, tabs, and decisions by voice.
Phone numbers are never shown, to anyone, including staff.
Never. Calls go through the app.
No one sees card numbers. Stripe keeps them.
Never.
The money is for the owner only.
Only the owner sees the money.
Never share anyone's details outside the panel.
Never. It's the law, and it's trust.
Ask the founder for a new password. You choose your own at first sign-in.
The founder can reset it.
Never give your password to anyone, even someone who says they're from us. Tell the founder.
Never share it. Report it.
Say sign me out. Always sign out on shared computers.
Say sign me out.

when: how do finds it requests work
replies: Look in up to three shops. Record what you found, where and the price, or say not found to refund the fee.
Three shops, then found or not found.
We never look for alcohol, tobacco, medicines or cash.
Never.

when: how do i check a shop product
replies: Check the name, price, photo and that it's allowed, then accept or turn it down.
Look at name, price and photo, then decide.
In Shops and organisations, press record a month paid for the plan, Spotlight or Spotlight Plus.
Record it under the shop.

when: how much is the partner plan
replies: {partnerPlan} a month. Spotlight {spotlight}, Spotlight Plus {spotlightPlus}.
{partnerPlan}, plus Spotlight if they choose.

when: what do i do with an enquiry
replies: Ring them within two working days, then say rung back.
Call them back, then mark it rung back.
Say any feedback and I'll read each one.
I'll read it out.
I'm {assistant}, here to help you run {product}.
I'm {assistant}. {motto}
To bring shopping to people who find it hard to get out, with dignity. {motto}
Shopping, brought with care, to people who need it.

when: how do i speak to a blind shopper
replies: Be clear, patient and plain. Say who you are and what you're doing.
Plain words, patience, and say who you are.
Tell the founder straight away. Every decision is recorded, so it can be put right.
Tell the founder. It can be fixed.

when: i'm not sure what to decide
replies: Ask a colleague or the founder before deciding. There's time.
Check before you decide.

when: who else is on the team
replies: The founder manages the team in the Team tab.
Ask the founder.
Your hours are agreed with the founder.
Agree them with the founder.
Goodbye. Thank you.
See you next time.
Alcohol, tobacco, medicines, cash and anything age restricted.
Those five, never.
{fee} for every delivery, the same for everyone.
{fee}, always.
{runnerPay} a job.
Runners earn {runnerPay} every job.
Well done. Check again later.
All clear. Thank you.
Of course. Say again, and I'll read it once more.
Say again, and I'll repeat it.
The law that protects people's information. We collect only what we need and keep it safe.
People's data, kept safe and private.
Ask the founder if you'd like extra protection on your sign-in.
Speak to the founder.
Listen to voice notes and look at photos before deciding.
Check the evidence first.
If the Shopper was responsible, there's no refund.
No refund when the Shopper was responsible.
We refund the Shopper and take it up with the shop.
We refund, then talk to the shop.
Yes, the panel works anywhere. Keep it private.
Anywhere, privately.

when: how many shoppers do we have
replies: The overview has the numbers, if it's part of your job.
Ask the founder, or see the overview.
Say turn off talking to silence me.
Say turn off talking.

when: how do i move through a list
how do i go through them
how do i hear the next one
replies: Say next for the next one, back for the one before, and again to hear it once more.
Next, back, or again.
Say again, and I'll read it once more.
Of course. Say again.

when: how do i go to the one before
how do i hear the earlier one
replies: Say back, and I'll read the one before.
Say back.

when: can i leave this one for later
replies: Say next. It stays waiting, and nothing is decided.
Say next. Nothing changes until you decide.

when: what do i say to decide
what are the words for a decision
replies: Say who was at fault and any refund, for example, nobody at fault, refund 2 pounds 50. I read it back and wait for your yes.
Say the decision in your own words. I'll read it back before anything happens.

when: do i have to say yes
why do you read it back
why do you ask me to confirm
replies: Yes. I read every decision back and only do it after your yes, so nothing happens by mistake.
So nothing is done by accident. Say yes to go ahead.
Then nothing is done. Say the decision again the way you want it.
Nothing happens without your yes. Just say it again.
Sorry. Don't say yes, and nothing is done. Say it again, a little slower.
My mistake. Say it again, and I'll read it back.

when: how do i say an amount
how do i say the refund amount
how do i say pounds and pence
replies: Say it as you would to a person, such as 2 pounds 50, or five pounds. I read it back first.
Pounds, then pence, the way you'd say it.

when: how do i accept by voice
how do i say yes to a runner
replies: When I've read the item, say accept. I read it back and wait for your yes.
Say accept, then yes.

when: how do i turn something down
how do i say no to a runner
how do i refuse by voice
replies: Say turn it down. I read it back and wait for your yes.
Say turn it down, then yes.

when: how do i open a tab by voice
how do i move to another part
replies: Say read me the, then the tab's name, such as read me the documents.
Say read me the documents, or whichever tab you need.
Say help, and I'll name the tabs your job can see.
Your job decides your tabs. Say help to hear them.
Say what's waiting, and I'll tell you everything that needs you.
Say what's waiting.
The speed is set by your phone or computer's voice settings. Change it there and I'll follow.
Your device's voice settings change my speed.
Turn up the volume on your device. Earphones help in a busy room, and keep things private.
Try the volume, or earphones.
Turn the volume down on your device. Say turn off talking if you'd like me silent.
Lower the volume, or say turn off talking.

when: how do i turn talking back on
replies: Turn the talking switch back on at the bottom of the screen, and I'll speak again.
Switch the talking back on.

when: do you listen all the time
replies: I only act on what's said to me in the panel. Sign out when you leave, and I stop.
Only in the panel, while you're signed in.
Yes. Everything I do by voice can be done on the screen with buttons too.
Yes, the screen works just as well.

when: do i have to use voice
replies: Not at all. Voice is there if it helps. The screen does everything too.
No, it's your choice.

when: is a voice decision the same as clicking
replies: Yes. A decision by voice is recorded with your name, exactly as one made on the screen.
Exactly the same, with your name on it.

when: can voice do more than my job
can i reach other tabs by voice
replies: No. Your job's limits apply by voice exactly as on the screen.
Voice follows the same limits as the screen.

when: will you take a shopping order here
can i do my own shopping here
replies: Nothing said in the admin panel is ever taken as a shopping order. Use the Shopper app for your own shopping.
Not in here. Use the app for shopping.

when: do i say my password aloud
replies: Please never say your password aloud. Passwords are always typed, so nobody nearby hears them.
Never speak it. Always type it.
Of course. I'll keep it short.
Short it is.
Overdue means it has waited past its two working days. Please do those first.
Past its deadline. Those come first.

when: when must i decide this one
what's the date to decide by
replies: I say the date with each complaint. Say again to hear it once more.
Say again, and listen for decide it by.
Sorry. Try shorter words, such as read me the complaints, next, or accept. Say help for the list.
Sorry. Say help to hear the words I know best.
Say what's waiting when you start, then read me the, and the tab. It's the quickest way through.
What's waiting, then read me the, and the tab.
I'm here. Say what's waiting when you're ready.
Yes, I'm listening.

when: how do i get your attention
replies: You can say {assistant} first, but in the panel you don't have to.
Just speak. My name is optional.
Earphones are a good idea. They keep names and details private and make me easier to hear.
Yes, they keep things private.
A quiet room, or earphones with a microphone, helps me hear you clearly.
Somewhere quieter helps.

when: can my colleague talk to you on my sign in
replies: Each person uses their own sign-in, so decisions carry the right name. Sign out before someone else starts.
Own sign-in for each person, please.
Say what's waiting, and I'll give you the count for each tab.
Say what's waiting.

when: what if the list is empty
replies: Then it's all done for now. Well done. Say what's waiting later to check again.
Nothing waiting. Check again later.
When the list ends I'll tell you. Say back to hear the one before.
I'll say when you reach the end.
Say read me the, and the tab again, and I'll start at the first one.
Say read me the, and the tab, to start over.
Welcome. Say what's waiting to hear your work, and help to hear what I can do. Ask the founder anything.
Welcome to the team. Say help to begin.

when: what do i do when i sign in
what happens when i sign in
replies: I tell you who you're signed in as and what's waiting. Then say read me the, and a tab.
I'll say what's waiting. Start there.

when: what am i signed in as
replies: I said your job when you signed in. Say what's waiting to hear it again.
Say what's waiting, and I'll tell you.

when: how do i get to the panel
replies: It's the staff page of our website. Sign in with your own username and password.
The staff page, with your own sign-in.
On the staff page, type your username and password. The first time, you'll choose your own password.
Username and password, on the staff page.
Check your username and type the password slowly. After five wrong tries, wait fifteen minutes. If it still fails, ask the founder.
Wait fifteen minutes after five tries, then ask the founder.
After five wrong tries you wait fifteen minutes. It keeps your account safe. Then try again, or ask the founder for a new password.
Wait fifteen minutes, then try again.
The founder chose it when adding you, often your name with a dot. Ask the founder.
Ask the founder.
Your first password is shown once to the founder. At first sign-in you choose your own, and nobody else will know it.
Use it once, then choose your own.

when: how long should my password be
replies: At least 10 characters. A short sentence that only you would think of works well.
At least 10 characters.

when: how do i change my password
replies: Ask the founder for a new password. When you next sign in, you choose your own again.
The founder gives a new one, then you choose your own.

when: does the founder know my password
replies: Nobody knows your password, not even the founder. It's stored so no one can read it.
Only you.
Type your new password carefully in both boxes, exactly the same. A screen reader can help you check each letter.
Type the same password in both boxes.
Say sign me out, or press Sign out at the top. Please always sign out when you finish.
Say sign me out.
The founder can sign everyone out for safety. Just sign in again. Nothing is lost.
Sign in again. Nothing is lost.
Only the founder can turn accounts on or off. Please speak to the founder.
Speak to the founder.
Only the founder can change your job. Ask, and explain what you need it for.
Ask the founder.

when: can i add someone to the team
can i make an account for someone
replies: Only the founder adds people to the team.
The founder does that.

when: can i use someone else's sign in
replies: No, please. Every decision records who made it, so each person uses their own sign-in.
Your own sign-in only.
Right to work, a DBS certificate, a driving licence and insurance. Check each one before accepting.
Right to work, DBS, licence and insurance.

when: how do i check runner papers
replies: Say read me the documents. I read each one, then say accept or turn it down.
Read me the documents, then decide each one.

when: what's the code from the government
replies: A code from the government that lets an employer check someone's right to work. I read it letter by letter.
The right to work code, checked on gov.uk.
Don't accept. Turn it down, so the Runner can send a new one. Ask the founder if you're unsure.
Turn it down, and they can send it again.
Say again, and I'll read the code once more, letter by letter.
Say again.
A check of someone's criminal record. Runners go into people's homes and handle their shopping, so it matters.
A record check. It keeps Shoppers safe.

when: what do i look for on a dbs
how do i check a dbs
what do i look for on a criminal record certificate
replies: The name matches the Runner, it's genuine and readable. If anything worries you, ask the founder before deciding.
Matching name, genuine, readable.

when: how do i check a driving licence
how do i check someone can drive
replies: The name matches, it's in date and readable. If something looks wrong, turn it down or ask the founder.
Name, date, readable.
The name matches, and it covers them now. Give the end date when you accept.
Matching name, in date, and give the end date.

when: what if their cover has ended
replies: Runners are reminded before it ends. An expired one shouldn't be accepted.
Don't accept an expired one.
Turn it down, so the Runner can send a clearer photo.
Turn it down for a clearer one.
Don't accept. Ask the founder. There may be a good reason, such as a married name, but it must be checked.
Check with the founder first.
Don't accept it. Tell the founder straight away, and say nothing to the Runner yet.
Don't accept. Tell the founder.

when: how do i check a photo document blind
replies: Share codes can be checked by voice. For photo documents, ask a sighted colleague or the founder to look with you.
Ask a colleague to look at photos with you.

when: how quickly should i check documents
how fast should new runners be cleared
replies: As soon as you can. A Runner can't start until they're checked, and they're waiting to earn.
Soon. They're waiting to start.
That document is marked as checked, with your name. When all are done, the Runner can start work.
It's recorded with your name.

when: what happens when i turn it down
replies: The Runner is asked to send it again. Nothing else changes.
They're asked to send it again.
Tell the founder straight away. Every decision is recorded, so it can be put right.
Tell the founder now.
Please ask a colleague or the founder to check that one, so it's fair to everyone.
Pass it to someone else, to keep it fair.
If you're unsure about anything in a Runner's documents, ask the founder before accepting.
When in doubt, ask the founder.

when: how do i decide a complaint
how do i settle a case
replies: Listen to the complaint and the evidence, then say who was at fault and any refund. I read it back and wait for yes.
Hear it, check the evidence, then decide.
Nobody, the Runner, the shop, us, or the Shopper.
Nobody, Runner, shop, us, or Shopper.

when: what does nobody at fault mean
what if nobody is to blame
replies: When things went wrong but no one was to blame, such as an item out of stock. We can still refund.
No one to blame, and we can still refund.

when: how much should i pay out
replies: What's fair for what went wrong, usually the cost of what was missing or damaged. Ask if unsure.
What's fair for what went wrong.

when: what's the limit for instant refunds
replies: {instantRefund} or less is refunded straight away, with no investigation.
{instantRefund} or less, at once.
Above {instantRefund}, check the evidence carefully first. If it's large or unclear, ask the founder.
Check carefully, and ask the founder if unsure.

when: can i refund more than they asked
can i pay out more than asked
replies: Refund what's fair. If you think more is due, check with the founder first.
What's fair. Check with the founder.

when: can i refund less than they asked
can i pay out less than asked
replies: Yes, if that's what's fair. Say the amount when you decide.
Yes, say the amount you think is fair.

when: when does the shopper get the money
how long does a refund take
how long until it reaches their card
replies: It goes back to their card. The bank decides how fast it shows, often a few days.
Back to their card, in a few days.
Runners report problems too. Read it the same way, check the evidence, and decide fairly.
The same way. Be fair to both sides.
Decide on what you have. Small ones up to {instantRefund} are refunded at once. For bigger ones, ask the founder.
Decide fairly on what you have.

when: how do i listen to the voice note
replies: Press play on the voice note in the complaint. Use earphones, as it may be private.
Press play, with earphones.
I can't describe photos. Ask a sighted colleague, or read the written notes with it.
Ask a colleague to look.
Stay calm and kind. People are usually upset about the problem, not you. Put it right fairly.
Calm and kind. Fix what you can.
Decide it fairly all the same. If it's abusive or threatening, tell the founder.
Be fair, and tell the founder if it's abusive.
Decide each one fairly, then tell the founder about the pattern.
Tell the founder about the pattern.

when: the same store keeps coming up
replies: Decide each one, then let the founder know, so we can talk to the shop.
Let the founder know.

when: too many complaints from one shopper
replies: Decide each one fairly on the evidence. If you're worried, tell the founder.
Fairly each time, and tell the founder.
Usually a refund for that item. Who was at fault depends on what happened.
Refund the item, and decide the fault.
Check the photo if there is one, then refund what's fair and decide who was at fault.
Check, refund fairly, decide the fault.
Refund the wrong item. Usually the Runner or the shop picked it, so decide from the evidence.
Refund, then decide who picked it.
Listen to what happened. Late isn't always anyone's fault, such as traffic or bad weather.
Find out why. It may be nobody's fault.
Take it seriously. Decide it, and tell the founder, as it may need a word with the Runner.
Decide it, and tell the founder.
Tell the founder straight away. If anyone is in danger right now, ring 999.
Founder at once. 999 if there's danger now.
Tell the founder today. If they may be in danger right now, ring 999.
Tell the founder. 999 in an emergency.

when: what if i miss the deadline
replies: Do the overdue ones first, and tell the founder if you need help catching up.
Overdue first, and ask for help.
Saturdays and Sundays don't count. Two working days from a Friday means by Tuesday.
Monday to Friday.
Phone numbers aren't shown to staff. Decide on the complaint and evidence, and ask the founder if you need more.
Numbers aren't shown. Ask the founder.

when: does the shopper hear my decision
replies: Yes, they're told the outcome and any refund.
Yes, they're told.

when: does the runner pay it back
replies: When the Runner is at fault, up to 10 percent of that job is taken back. The Shopper is refunded by us.
Up to 10 percent of that job.
Tell the founder straight away. It's recorded, so it can be put right.
Tell the founder now.

when: can i talk about a complaint
replies: Yes. Only talk about complaints in the panel or with the team, never outside.
Private. Keep it in the panel.
Do the overdue ones, then the oldest. Tell the founder; help can be arranged.
Overdue first, then tell the founder.
It's what Runners tell us about the app and the work. Read it, and pass good ideas to the founder.
Runners' thoughts. Pass on good ideas.

when: do i answer what runners say
replies: Feedback is for reading. Pass anything important to the founder.
Read it, and pass on what matters.
Some people give no name. Treat it with the same respect.
Respect it all the same.
That's useful. It's how we get better. Pass it on to the founder.
Useful. Pass it on.
Wonderful. Share it with the founder, it helps everyone.
Lovely. Pass it on.
Tell the founder straight away.
Founder, straight away.

when: the app isn't working for them
replies: Pass it to the founder with as much detail as you have.
Tell the founder, with details.
Money a Runner owes after a problem that was their fault. Small amounts can be written off.
What Runners owe after a problem.
Say read me the money owed, and I'll go through them.
Say read me the money owed.

when: how do i write something off
replies: When I read one that's small enough, say write it off. I read it back and wait for your yes.
Say write it off, then yes.

when: it's too big to write off
it's too large to let go
replies: Then please ask the Runner for it, kindly. Ask the founder if they can't pay.
Ask the Runner, kindly.

when: how do i ask a runner to pay
replies: Kindly and clearly: what happened, how much, and how they can pay. Ask the founder for the right way to contact them.
Kindly and clearly. Ask the founder how.
Tell the founder. We'll find a fair way.
Tell the founder.

when: i wrote off the wrong one
replies: Tell the founder straight away. It's recorded, so it can be put right.
Tell the founder now.
Chasing small amounts costs more in time and goodwill than it's worth.
Small amounts aren't worth the upset.

when: can finance see what came in
replies: No. The takings are for the owner only. You see what Runners owe.
Owner only.
Payouts and the accounts may come to the finance job later. For now, it's money owed.
Later. For now, money owed.

when: how does the special search work
replies: A Shopper asks us to find something. You look in up to three local shops and say what you found.
We look for something special for a Shopper.

when: how many shops do i try
how many stores do i try
replies: Up to three shops, by phone or in person.
Up to three.

when: how do i say i found it
the item turned up what now
replies: Say found it. Then give what you found, where, and the price.
Say found it.

when: how do i say i couldn't find it
replies: Say not found. The Shopper gets the fee back.
Say not found, and the fee goes back.

when: what does the special search cost
replies: The Shopper pays a fee for the search, and it's given back if nothing is found.
The fee comes back if nothing is found.

when: can i go to more shops
can i try a fourth store
replies: Three is the limit. If it's not found by then, say not found.
Three, then not found.

when: it's similar but not the same
replies: Record it as found, and say clearly how it's different, so the Shopper can choose.
Say exactly how it differs.
I say the area with each request, so you can try shops near them.
I'll say the area.
Tell the founder before looking. We never look for anything age restricted.
Ask the founder first.
We never look for alcohol, tobacco, medicines or cash. Say not found, so the fee goes back, and the founder can explain.
Never. Say not found.
That's fine. Say found it or not found when you're done. It stays waiting until then.
It waits for you.
Try another, up to three. If none have it, say not found.
Try the next shop.
Give the price you were told today. Prices can change in shops.
Today's price.

when: who asks to work with us
replies: Councils, charities, care providers and shops that want to work with us.
Organisations and shops.

when: how quickly do i ring back
replies: Within two working days.
Two working days.

when: how do i mark it done
replies: Say rung back, and I'll mark it. I read it back and wait for yes.
Say rung back.
Say again, and I'll read the number in pairs.
Say again.

when: what do i say on the call
replies: Thank them, ask what they need and how many people they support, and explain what we do. Note what they say.
Thank them, listen, explain.
Leave a short message with your name, and try again later. Only say rung back once you've spoken.
Try again later.
Delivery is {fee}, the same for everyone. For anything special, say the founder will come back to them.
{fee} for delivery. The founder handles anything special.
Please don't promise discounts or deals. The founder decides those.
Only the founder can.
Lovely. Ring them back, find out what they need, and tell the founder.
Ring back, and tell the founder.

when: how do i set up an organisation
how do i set up a council account
replies: Partnerships set up organisation accounts once they've agreed to work with us. Ask the founder if you're unsure how.
Ask the founder for the steps.
No call needed. Tell the founder if it keeps happening.
Skip it, and tell the founder.
Please pass anything from the press to the founder, and don't comment yourself.
Pass it to the founder.

when: what are the items waiting to go on sale
replies: Products partner shops send to sell through us. You check each one before it goes on, usually within one working day.
Partner shops' products, to check.
I'll read each one: the shop, the name, the price, labels and best before date. Then accept or turn it down.
One at a time, then decide.
Ask yourself if the Shopper can tell what it is. If not, turn it down so the shop can add one.
Turn it down if it's unclear.
Turn it down, so the shop can check the price.
Turn it down to be checked.
Turn it down. We never sell alcohol, tobacco, medicines or anything age restricted.
Turn it down.

when: what about the best before date
replies: If it's past its date or very close, turn it down.
Out of date means turn it down.
What the shop says about it, such as halal, vegan or gluten free. Check they make sense.
The shop's description, such as vegan.
Spotlight shows a shop more prominently, for {spotlight} a month, or {spotlightPlus} for Spotlight Plus.
Extra visibility for a shop.
Ring them back from Enquiries, and tell the founder.
Ring back, and tell the founder.
Listen kindly, note what they say, and tell the founder.
Listen, and pass it to the founder.
Numbers about how the business is doing: purchases, busiest shops, hours and days. No names, only groups of ten or more.
How the business is doing, without names.
The founder, and anyone the founder switches it on for.
The founder decides.
So nobody can be picked out. That's how we protect people's privacy.
So nobody can be identified.
What Shoppers searched for that nobody had. It helps us find new shops and products.
What people want and can't find yet.

when: how many runners do we have
replies: How many Shoppers, Runners, shops, organisations and staff, and what's waiting. It's for the founder and those it's switched on for.
People and work, no money.
The founder adds people, changes jobs, gives new passwords and turns accounts off there.
The founder's tab for the team.
